title: Componentwise monicity of cartesian extension-by-zero exchange
statement: Let ℓ be prime, k a field of positive prime characteristic different from ℓ, and Λ a commutative condensed ring. Let X, Z, Xprime and Zprime be separated finite-type k-schemes, with k-morphisms j:X→Z, g:Zprime→Z, jprime:Xprime→Zprime and gprime:Xprime→X forming a cartesian square; assume j and jprime are open immersions. Use the bounded constructible functors of [sk-def-sfb-dc-restricted-functors] and the unit-square-counit exchange formula of [def-sfb-dc-open-base-change-morphism]. Let α be a natural transformation gprime^* ⋙ jprime_! → j_! ⋙ g^* equal to this explicit formula. For every bounded constructible Λ_X-module complex K, the component α_K is a monomorphism.

proof.text: Use the existing ordinary abelian-sheaf openImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso, obtained by conjugating weakly-etale base change. Thus the underlying abelian sheaf of g^*(j_! M) lies in the essential image of jprime_!. The fully faithful abelian extension by zero has invertible counit on this essential image. This uses no equality between the module exchange and the sheaf exchange.

The scalar-extension forgetful comparison profinitePointModuleForgetPullbackIso identifies the underlying sheaf of module pullback with ordinary abelian inverse image. The already proved openUnitIsIso from the condensed open/closed recollement supplies the module extension-by-zero unit isomorphism. The linear extension-by-zero adjunction has the ordinary sheaf hom-equivalence after forgetting. Consequently its counit on g^*(j_! M) is invertible by the first step, since Mod.forget reflects isomorphisms. Restriction and coextension along the coefficient isomorphism are equivalences. The composite-adjunction counit formula and transport by the coextension/extension isomorphism therefore give the same invertibility for the actual module extension-by-zero adjunction.

Let F=j_! followed by g^*, R=jprime^*, and L=jprime_! on module objects. The natural transformation F followed by R followed by L to F, formed from the counit, is an isomorphism by step 2. Apply mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso to obtain D(F) followed by D(R) followed by D(L) isomorphic to D(F). The unit-isomorphism theorem for mapDerivedCategoryAdjunction makes D(L) fully faithful. The displayed isomorphism places every D(F)(K) in its essential image; Adjunction.isIso_counit_app_of_iso proves that the derived counit is invertible there.

The boundedConstructibleUpperStarCompatibility, leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory, and boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriekCompatibility isomorphisms identify the ambient object underlying g^*(j_! K) with D(F)(K). Transport the derived counit invertibility along this object isomorphism. Expanding only the right-adjoint transport and applying map_restrictFullyFaithful_counit_app shows that the inclusion maps the bounded-constructible counit to a composite of isomorphisms. The fully faithful inclusion reflects isomorphisms. Similarly, restriction of the fully faithful derived extension by zero is fully faithful, so the bounded-constructible adjunction unit is invertible.

Rewrite alpha using the supplied equality h_alpha. Its component is the composite of the left-unitor inverse, a functor applied to the invertible unit, the square-transport isomorphism, the invertible counit from step 4, and the right unitor. Hence alpha_K is an isomorphism and therefore monic. No component inverse is selected and no naturality assertion for selected inverses is needed.

proof_origin.place: C3: prove module support by forgetting the linear counit; derive its natural isomorphism, restrict the counit, and prove the original unit-square-counit component invertible. The ordinary sheaf exchange is used only to detect essential-image support.

lean.statement:
theorem boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChange_app_mono
    (sq : IsPullback g' j' j g)
    (α : boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ g' ⋙
        boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriek Λ ℓ j' ⟶
      boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriek Λ ℓ j ⋙
        boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ g)
    (hα : α =
      ((Functor.leftUnitor _).inv ≫ Functor.whiskerRight
        (boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction Λ ℓ j).unit
        (boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ g' ⋙
          boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriek Λ ℓ j')) ≫
      (Functor.squareTransport (boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriek Λ ℓ j)
        (boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriek Λ ℓ j')
        (boundedConstructiblePullbackSquareComparison Λ ℓ sq.toCommSq.flip)).hom ≫
      (Functor.whiskerLeft
        (boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriek Λ ℓ j ⋙
          boundedConstructibleUpperStar Λ ℓ g)
        (boundedConstructibleOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction Λ ℓ j').counit ≫
        (Functor.rightUnitor _).hom))
    (K : Dᵇc(X.left)⟦Λ⟧) :
    Mono (α.app K)
